0.text: It’s  time for us to rid the country of this scum. Make sure you get a spot towards the front - the blood splatter’s the best part.  There’s sure to be a great crowd.

2.text: A grand show, was it not $NAME ? I must speak with Bishop Roma and inform him the deed is done.... Take leave now and find me later. I will have orders for you then.

0.text: It’s about time you showed up. Did you enjoy your holiday, “your majesty?” By the goddess, anyone would think you’d been off conspiring with the enemy by the way you look.

1.text: Not been sleeping much since Lord Oscar’s execution, huh? Don’t feel guilty over it, he was a blasphemer and a traitor, you know that.

2.text: Still, there’s something different about you… I just can’t place it...

0.text: Alright, seems like you’re doing a good job. Bishop Roma trusts you, Guild City trusts you, hell, the whole bloody Midlands trust you, so I guess I might be able to as well.

1.text: Take this letter - don’t open it - and deliver it to my contact at Lakewood Inn. Look for the man in the Green Hat near the stables.

0.text: You’re back. I knew I could trust you. Thank you for your discretion $NAME. This is for you.
You’re back. Hmm… You didn’t read it did you? Well, I suppose you wouldn’t tell me, even if you had…
Never, I am here to serve.
Very well here is your pay.
I’ve no need of you for now, go find something to pass the time yourself. Get a straw hat and take up fishing for all I care, I have much to plan...
